# nix and overlay

Imported from `@adrifer/winix`. Usage: [Linux and macOS helpers](../reference/nix.md#nix-expressions).

## nix

### nix.expr()

Any Nix expression, written as is: `nix.expr("pkgs.lib.licenses.unfree")`.

```ts
nix.expr(expr: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.pkg()

A nixpkgs package: `nix.pkg("zsh")` is `pkgs.zsh`.

```ts
nix.pkg(name: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.pkg.stable()

`pkgs.stable.<name>`, from the nixpkgs input `overlay.stable` adds.

```ts
nix.pkg.stable(name: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.bin()

The path of an executable in a package: `nix.bin("git", "git")` is `"${pkgs.git}/bin/git"`.

```ts
nix.bin(packageName: string, executable: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.homePath()

Build a safely quoted path below `config.home.homeDirectory`.
Leading `/` characters are ignored; other characters are preserved.

```ts
nix.homePath(relativePath: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.pkgPath()

Build a safely quoted path below `pkgs.<packageName>`.
Leading `/` characters are ignored; other characters are preserved.

```ts
nix.pkgPath(packageName: string, relativePath: string): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.str()

A Nix string with expressions interpolated:
nix.str`${nix.pkg("neovim")}/bin/nvim` is `"${pkgs.neovim}/bin/nvim"`.

```ts
nix.str(strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: NixStringPart[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.script()

A multi-line Nix string (`'' ... ''`) for scripts, with expressions interpolated and indentation trimmed.

```ts
nix.script(body: string): NixExpr
nix.script(strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: NixStringPart[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.script.raw()

Like `nix.script`, but backslashes stay exactly as typed (a raw template).

```ts
nix.script.raw(strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: NixStringPart[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.concat()

Strings and expressions joined with Nix's `+`.

```ts
nix.concat(...parts: NixStringPart[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.withPkgs()

A package list: `nix.withPkgs(["git", "curl"])` is `with pkgs; [ git curl ]`.

```ts
nix.withPkgs(packages: string[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.optionalAttrs()

Attributes included only when `condition` holds, decided by Nix (`lib.optionalAttrs`).

```ts
nix.optionalAttrs(condition: NixCondition, attrs: Record<string, unknown>): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.optionalString()

A string included only when `condition` holds, decided by Nix (`lib.optionalString`).

```ts
nix.optionalString(condition: NixCondition, value: NixStringPart): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.isDarwin

```ts
nix.isDarwin: NixExpr
```

`pkgs.stdenv.isDarwin`, for conditions.

### nix.isLinux

```ts
nix.isLinux: NixExpr
```

`pkgs.stdenv.isLinux`, for conditions.

### nix.binaryRelease()

Build a `stdenvNoCC.mkDerivation` for a prebuilt single-binary CLI
release (the `azd`, `gh`, `kubectl`, `1password` family).

Picks the right `(file, hash)` per `pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.system`,
substitutes `{version}`, `{file}`, and (optionally) `{platform}` into
`urlTemplate`, fetches with `pkgs.fetchurl`, unpacks tarballs/zips (or
directly installs raw executables), and `install -Dm755`s the binary
into `$out/bin/<binary>`.

Optional extensions:
- `completions` — emits `installShellCompletion` for `bash`/`fish`/`zsh`.
- `linuxPatchelf` — enables `autoPatchelfHook` on Linux only.
- `linuxBuildInputs` — extra runtime libs the auto-patchelf hook needs.
- `dontStripDarwin` — keep the binary's Mach-O signature intact (default `true`).

`meta.license` accepts a nixpkgs `pkgs.lib.licenses` attribute name
(e.g. `"mit"`, `"asl20"`, `"unfree"`) or a `NixExpr`. SPDX-style ids
like `"MIT"` or `"Apache-2.0"` are rejected at TS-eval time.

```ts
nix.binaryRelease({
  name: "azure-dev-cli",
  version: "1.25.5",
  binary: "azd",
  urlTemplate:
    "https://github.com/Azure/azure-dev/releases/download/azure-dev-cli_{version}/{file}",
  platforms: {
    "x86_64-linux":  { file: "azd-linux-amd64.tar.gz",  hash: "sha256-..." },
    "aarch64-linux": { file: "azd-linux-arm64.tar.gz",  hash: "sha256-..." },
    "x86_64-darwin": { file: "azd-darwin-amd64.zip",    hash: "sha256-..." },
    "aarch64-darwin":{ file: "azd-darwin-arm64.zip",    hash: "sha256-..." },
  },
  meta: {
    description: "Azure Developer CLI",
    homepage: "https://github.com/Azure/azure-dev",
    license: "mit",
  },
});
```

```ts
nix.binaryRelease(opts: BinaryReleaseOpts): NixExpr
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | `pname` for the derivation. |
| `version` | `string` | `version` for the derivation. |
| `binary` | `string` | Final binary name placed in `$out/bin/<binary>`. |
| `urlTemplate` | `string` | URL with `{version}`, `{file}` and optional `{platform}` placeholders. Must contain `{file}`. |
| `platforms` | `Partial<Record<BinaryReleaseArch, BinaryReleasePlatform>>` | One entry per supported `(os, arch)`. At least one required. |
| `extraInstall?` | `string` | Extra install lines appended after the main `install -Dm755`. |
| `linuxPatchelf?` | `boolean` | Opt-in: add `autoPatchelfHook` to `nativeBuildInputs` on Linux. Use this for ELF binaries that link against shared libraries. Pass any required runtime libraries via `linuxBuildInputs`. |
| `linuxBuildInputs?` | `(string \| NixExpr)[]` | Extra `buildInputs` to expose on Linux only, typically shared libs needed by `autoPatchelfHook` (e.g. `["stdenv.cc.cc"]`). Values are emitted as raw Nix expressions under `pkgs.` unless they are already `NixExpr`. |
| `dontStripDarwin?` | `boolean` | Default `true`: emits `dontStrip = pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.isDarwin;` to avoid breaking signed Darwin binaries. Set `false` to opt out. |
| `completions?` | `BinaryReleaseCompletions` | Shell completion script generation. Each entry is the command (or absolute path) that prints the completion script for that shell. Adds `installShellFiles` to `nativeBuildInputs` and runs `installShellCompletion` in `postInstall`. |
| `meta` | `BinaryReleaseMeta` | The package's metadata. |

**`completions`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bash?` | `string` | Command (or absolute path) that emits a bash completion script when run. |
| `fish?` | `string` | Command (or absolute path) that emits a fish completion script when run. |
| `zsh?` | `string` | Command (or absolute path) that emits a zsh completion script when run. |

**`meta`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `string` | One line about the tool (`meta.description`). |
| `homepage?` | `string` | Its home page (`meta.homepage`). |
| `license?` | `string \| NixExpr` | nixpkgs `lib.licenses` attribute name (e.g. `"mit"`, `"asl20"`, `"unfree"`). **Not** an SPDX identifier: `"MIT"` and `"Apache-2.0"` will be rejected. Pass a `NixExpr` (e.g. `nix.expr("pkgs.lib.licenses.unfree")`) for licenses that aren't a simple attribute lookup. |
| `mainProgram?` | `string` | Defaults to the outer `binary`. |

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.wsl

Helpers for NixOS-WSL hosts reaching into Windows.

#### nix.wsl.windowsBin()

Package with `bin/<name>`: a shim that runs the first existing Windows
executable among `paths`. Paths are absolute (`C:\\...`) or start with
an environment variable (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\\...`), resolved through interop
on each run, so no Windows user name or drive is hard-coded.

```ts
home.packages(nix.wsl.windowsBin("code-insiders",
  "%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code Insiders\\bin\\code-insiders"));
```

```ts
nix.wsl.windowsBin(name: string, paths: string | readonly string[]): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

### nix.lib

nixpkgs `lib` functions for option priorities and ordering.

#### nix.lib.mkDefault()

A value other declarations override (`lib.mkDefault`).

```ts
nix.lib.mkDefault(value: unknown): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.lib.mkForce()

A value that overrides other declarations (`lib.mkForce`).

```ts
nix.lib.mkForce(value: unknown): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.lib.mkBefore()

List or string content placed before the rest (`lib.mkBefore`).

```ts
nix.lib.mkBefore(value: unknown): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.lib.mkAfter()

List or string content placed after the rest (`lib.mkAfter`).

```ts
nix.lib.mkAfter(value: unknown): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.lib.optionalAttrs()

Same as `nix.optionalAttrs`.

```ts
nix.lib.optionalAttrs(condition: NixCondition, attrs: Record<string, unknown>): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

#### nix.lib.optionalString()

Same as `nix.optionalString`.

```ts
nix.lib.optionalString(condition: NixCondition, value: NixStringPart): NixExpr
```

Returns a Nix expression, usable wherever a value goes.

## overlay

### overlay.stable()

Make another nixpkgs input available as `pkgs.stable` (for `nix.pkg.stable`),
on NixOS and macOS hosts.

```ts
overlay.stable("nixpkgsStable")
```

```ts
overlay.stable(inputName: string): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

### overlay.custom()

Add an overlay written in Nix (`final: prev: { ... }`) on NixOS and macOS hosts.

```ts
overlay.custom(expr: string): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

### overlay.darwin

The same, for macOS hosts only.

#### overlay.darwin.stable()

`overlay.stable`, for macOS hosts only.

```ts
overlay.darwin.stable(inputName: string): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

#### overlay.darwin.custom()

`overlay.custom`, for macOS hosts only.

```ts
overlay.darwin.custom(expr: string): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.
